name: Night Run
summary: In east-central Ashenvale, Night Run crowns a cliff-ringed bluff among the ancient elven ruins. Felmusk satyr dwell there, and dark soul magic gathers within the outpost.

sections.title: A Defended Cliffside Perch
sections.body: Night Run is Ashenvale’s smallest and most isolated of its three major satyr strongholds, alongside Xavian and Satyrnaar. Crumbling elven stonework and broken pillars shelter the settlement on a high ridge bounded by steep, impassable cliffs. Travelers can reach it by following the Falfarren River near the waters of Xavian, then turning west up the ridge, or by taking a precarious northern ledge above Raynewood Retreat. Though small, the enclave is dangerous. The Felmusk satyr work with the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand, anchoring twisted soulgems to gather demonic essence within the forest.

faq.answer: The Felmusk satyr occupy Night Run. These demonic night elf corrupters are affiliated with the Cult of the Dark Strand.

faq.q: How do you reach Night Run?
aliases: how to get to night run
faq.answer: Night Run lies on an elevated bluff bounded by sheer cliffs. You can approach by a narrow ledge north of Raynewood Retreat or follow the Falfarren River toward Xavian before turning west up the ridge.

faq.q: What is the Cult of the Dark Strand doing here?
aliases: cult of the dark strand night run
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand works alongside the satyrs, maintaining a dark soulgem at Night Run to harvest and channel demonic energies across Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you see an enduring scar in Night Run: ancient elven stones shelter the twisted Felmusk.
As an Alliance traveler, you find Night Run just north of Raynewood Retreat, a demonic menace overlooking crucial Sentinel supply lines.
